Official press release · Orlando, Florida

Brazilian from São Gonçalo announces the founding of United Florida FC in Orlando, United States, and signs with Reebok to dress the team

The new club will be based in Orlando and make its official UPSL debut in 2027.

ORLANDO, FLORIDA, UNITED STATES. Businessman Maicon Vilela, 38, from São Gonçalo, Rio de Janeiro, officially announces the founding of United Florida FC, based in Orlando, Florida, in the United States.

The club is born big: it has signed with Reebok to dress the team. The American brand will dress the first team in the UPSL, every youth team in the US and the franchises planned in Brazil.

With all of its companies expected to be fully registered in January 2027, the official debut in the UPSL, one of the main national leagues in the United States and the way into the Lamar Hunt US Open Cup, is set for the 2027 season.

Who is Maicon Vilela

Maicon Vilela has more than 10 years in Rio de Janeiro soccer. He started on major Rio radio stations and became one of the boldest names in Rio soccer in recent years.

He founded Clube Atlético Carioca and refounded the traditional Niteroiense Futebol Clube.

He became known nationwide for high-profile signings that stopped the sports press, such as Túlio Maravilha, a Botafogo legend; Acosta, the Uruguayan striker who played for Corinthians and Náutico; and goalkeeper Bruno, formerly of Flamengo.

Earlier this year, he sold the Clube Atlético Carioca brand to the G10 group and is now 100% focused on the American project in Orlando.

The goal: to be the Brazilian club in Florida

United Florida FC's big bet is to become the Brazilian club in Florida and play in the US Open Cup, a tournament that gives a real chance to face MLS clubs such as Messi's Inter Miami, Orlando City and Los Angeles FC.

“I went through major Rio radio stations, founded Atlético Carioca, refounded Niteroiense and signed players the whole of Brazil talked about. I sold Atlético this year and now my full focus is Orlando, in the United States. By January all the companies will be fully set up here in Orlando, and our official UPSL debut will be in 2027. We signed with Reebok to dress the team. That dream of playing the US Open Cup against the MLS giants is what we are going to offer,” says Maicon Vilela, president of United Florida FC.

Franchises in Brazil

The project plans official franchises all over Brazil. Each franchisee will have exclusive rights in their city, use of the international brand and a place on the official US website.

Tryouts United Florida FC in Brazil

Official soccer tryouts for players aged 14 to 23. Those who pass train with us for 12 months in Brazil, and the standouts are evaluated to play in the UPSL in the United States.

  1. Phase 1 · Brazil 12 months of development and high performance Competitions and an American-standard methodology, here in Brazil.
  2. Phase 2 · United States The standouts are evaluated for the UPSL To play for United Florida FC in the league where academies like Inter Miami, Orlando City and DME Academy compete.

Passing the tryouts does not guarantee a move to the United States: selection for phase 2 follows technical, behavioral and development criteria throughout the project.

Frequently asked questions

What players, families and future franchisees ask most about the club.

Another question? Talk to the club
What is the UPSL?

The United Premier Soccer League is one of the main national soccer leagues in the United States, with clubs in many states. For United Florida FC, it is the way into the Lamar Hunt US Open Cup.

What is the age range for the tryouts?

The tryouts are for players aged 14 to 23, in the U-15, U-17, U-20 and U-23 age groups. Players under 18 must come with a parent or guardian.

How do the tryouts in Brazil work?

Pick your age group, fill in the sign-up and pay by Pix. Players approved on the day train with the club for 12 months in Brazil, with competitions and an American-standard methodology. After that, the standouts are evaluated to play for United Florida FC in the UPSL, in the United States. Passing the tryouts does not guarantee the move: phase 2 follows technical, behavioral and development criteria.

When does the club debut?

The official UPSL debut is set for the 2027 season, with all of the club's companies fully registered in Orlando by January 2027.

How do I buy the official shirt?

Pick the model and size in the store and add it to your bag. When you check out, the order goes straight to the club's WhatsApp, and the club confirms the price, shipping and payment with you.

How does the franchise in Brazil work?

The franchisee gets exclusive rights in the city, uses the international brand and the Reebok kit, and is featured on the club's official US website. To learn about the model, talk to the club on WhatsApp.
